exact_economic_objective.scope: Static reference-capital daily price/cost proxy identical to saved-policy evaluation; not shared-wallet NAV, funding-inclusive utility or native certification.
exact_economic_objective.daily_gross: g[t]=sum_a w[t,a]*r[t+1,a]; r realized for training labels, never a current feature.
exact_economic_objective.causal_trade: delta[0]=w[0]; delta[t]=w[t]-w[t-1]*(1+r[t,a]); previous realized return is known at current decision. On mask exits previous holding is retained for paid trade calculation.
exact_economic_objective.final_trade: delta_terminal=-w[last]*(1+r[last+1]); cost assigned to final mature label end, not an extra future date. Each independently scored block starts flat and pays entry/end.
exact_economic_objective.per_asset_cost: C(delta)=(fee+half_spread+slippage)*abs(delta)+fee*(half_spread+slippage)*delta. Exact fee on adverse fill notional; no duplicate execution debit.
exact_economic_objective.daily_net: sum(w*r) -sum current-trade C; final day additionally pays terminal C.
exact_economic_objective.training_loss: -sqrt365*mean(daily_net)/sqrt(population_centered_variance(daily_net)+1e-9), float64 objective. Existing fixed numerical epsilon, report its train denominator fraction; not tuned on validation and not used in scored Sharpe.
exact_economic_objective.scored_sharpe: sqrt365*mean(daily_net)/sqrt(population_centered_variance(daily_net)); zero/nonfinite variance or all-cash =>INVALID, never epsilon score.
exact_economic_objective.abs_kink: Declared sign(0)=0 subgradient; finite differences verified off kinks. No smooth abs, dead-zone, holding constraint, rescaling knob, fee/penalty/risk sweep.
exact_economic_objective.funding: NOT_MEASURED_NOT_KNOWN_ZERO; bound actual funding and native execution only after independent economic gate and separate reviewed readiness plan.
exact_economic_objective.risk: Old raw desired-target caps abs .3/gross .6 retained as STOP checks, no silent clipping or rescaling. Marked drift/risk-reduction, native minimum10USDT/lot/capacity/latency/collateral not represented or qualified by this proxy.

computation.gradient: Reuse temporal memory-bounded output-VJP pattern: no-grad causal positions on complete train axis, exact float64 dLoss/dPosition, recompute identical deterministic LSTM windows in chunks128 and accumulate parameter VJP; apply ONE Adam step after full gradient. Assert replayed outputs equal and test small full-autograd gradient equivalence before fit. Chunking never splits costs or changes objective.
